# Isomorphic Arms (weapon transfer)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, core-talent, god-of-machines

## Derived / confirmed formula

Minions gain the Main-Hand weapon's Base Damage + affixes (glossary 'Applied Weapon Bonuses'), but NOT its Base Attack Speed / Base Crit Rating. +30% additional Spell Damage for Minions when wielding a Wand or Tin Staff.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified in-game. Sequences/dream affixes flow through once those are wired.

## Implementation (engine model)

aggregator.py transfers weapon1 gear contributions to minion pools via to_minion_stat_strict AFTER core-talent+node loops (base AS/crit have no minion twin -> dropped). Effect 1 resolves via the minion-scope peel + the existing wielding_wand_or_tin_staff condition. Verified: DPS 1079->2688, weapon base dmg 200/350 transferred, base AS not.
